dogecoin.text: Memecoins surge as Dogecoin and others outperform the crypto market in response to Trump’s victory in the US presidential election, with the memecoin market cap hitting a seven-month high of $66.72 billion.

Trump appoints Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy to lead the new Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), aiming to cut waste from $6.5 trillion in federal spending. Dogecoin ($DOGE) surges 150% post-election as the duo targets government bureaucracy.

Dogecoin investor lawsuit against Elon Musk dropped after two years; plaintiffs withdraw their appeal and waive rights to further litigation. The suit originally claimed Musk manipulated DOGE prices through his social media presence. $DOGE
